bead.title: Surface release-workflow failures
bead.description:
PROBLEM: A failed release run can finish without any visible alert.
ROOT CAUSE: `.github/workflows/release.yml:18-189` defines the release job and publish path, but it has no failure notification or explicit blocking status check around the release gate; the failed v0.8.0 run 28641569553 had no surfaced alert.
PROPOSED FIX: add a release-workflow failure notification or required status check that visibly reports a failed release run before publication is considered healthy.
NON-SCOPE: PR CI matrix expansion, backend compile fixes, and release artifact packaging logic.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestReleaseFailureAlertExists: `rg -n 'failure|notify|status check|alert' .github/workflows/release.yml` shows the new alerting or blocking step.
2. TestReleaseFailureIsVisible: a synthetic failed release-workflow run or workflow-unit test proves the alert/status is emitted.
3. TestGoTestGate: `go test ./...` passes.
4. TestLefthookGate: `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
